decision: At which target density ratios (10/100/1000) is a PR-EOS Shan-Chen single-component pseudopotential static droplet a usable construct, and what is the spurious-current floor and density-ratio maintenance error at each ratio?

alternatives.A1_edm: Exact-Difference Method (EDM) forcing with standard pressure discretisation
alternatives.A2_guo: Guo forcing with standard pressure discretisation

hypothesis: H1: the Maxwell equal-area construction correctly predicts the coexistence pair for the PR-EOS at any subcritical T_r, and the discrete SCMP scheme can hold the predicted density ratio within 15% at ratio=10 with spurious Ma < 0.05. H0 (falsifier): ratio_error > 15% OR spurious Ma > 0.10 at ratio=10.

metrics.spurious_ma: max|u| / c_s over the final 5 samples
metrics.collapse_step: step at which non-finite rho, negative rho, or |u|/cs > 0.5 occurs (if any)

baseline_control.physical_baseline: the Maxwell equal-area coexistence pair (analytic, recomputed at run time by sc_eos_coexistence.maxwell_coexistence)
baseline_control.representation_control: planar-interface control runs measure the coexistence pair the lattice scheme actually selects in the absence of curvature, separating EOS-vs-scheme discretisation error from droplet geometry effects

predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: A run is PASS iff stable >= 20000 steps AND ratio_error <= 15% AND spurious Ma <= 0.05 AND no clamp exposure AND mass drift rate <= 5e-8/step

stopping_rule: Each run stops at the predeclared step count (20000 for tiers, 40000 for longhold) or at collapse onset (non-finite rho, negative rho beyond roundoff, |u|/cs > 0.5, or psi clamp engagement). No arm is extended after looking at KPIs.

physics_arm.case: Static droplet in periodic box, evolved to mechanical equilibrium with EDM forcing
physics_arm.reference: Maxwell equal-area coexistence pair from sc_eos_coexistence.maxwell_coexistence
physics_arm.note: The planar-interface control arm separates curvature effects from scheme discretisation error

analysis: Report A1 vs A2 vs A3 per KPI with explicit pass/fail vs the predeclared thresholds; distinguish the forcing scheme effect from the pressure discretisation effect; no threshold tuning after seeing results
safety_resource_limits: CPU float32, single process, 900 s wall-clock budget per arm on local; cluster queue for full campaign

external_anchor.eos_params: Yuan & Schaefer (2006) Phys. Fluids 18 042101 — PR-EOS parameters for pseudopotential LBM
external_anchor.maxwell_method: Maxwell equal-area construction in specific-volume space: ∫_{v_l}^{v_v} [p(v) − p_sat] dv = 0
external_anchor.edm_forcing: Li, Luo & Li (2012) Phys. Rev. E 86 016709 — exact-difference method for large density ratio
external_anchor.implementation: src/tensorlbm/sc_eos_coexistence.py (Maxwell solver), src/tensorlbm/multiphase.py (psi_eos factories), benchmarks/eos_maxwell/probe_lib.py (probe driver)
